About the Atlassian Design System

Learn about the design system, the benefits of using it, and our values and principles.

The parts of the design system

The Atlassian Design System is a collection of design guidelines, foundations, tools, and components. It is built and supported by Atlassian developers, designers, and content designers.

Our values

  1. Foundational: We solve common problems.

  2. Harmonious: Our building blocks work together.

Our principles

1. Trusted fundamentals before comprehensive patterns

  • We solve common foundational problems first.

2. Meet system needs before delivering individual features
